Clad (YC W23) | Software Engineer | NYC | withclad.com

Clad is construction software for building infrastructure. We help contractors track their work and automate their back office.

We're a 7 person team in-person in New York City, raised $2.7M, have >3 years of runway, and are growing faster than we ever have.

You'll build a well-crafted product, and work on challenging problems at intersection of AI, construction (mapping), and fintech.

Apply here: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/clad/jobs/YHGyRSf-soft...

Or email me at jason [at] withclad [dot] com
